create_eplb_communicator: create an EPLB communicator for expert weight transfers using a specified backend like torch_nccl, torch_gloo, pynccl, or nixl
has_nixl: check whether the optional NIXL or RIXL package is available for direct memory transfer
test_torch_dist_nccl_communicator: test the TorchDistNcclEplbCommunicator that uses torch.distributed isend/irecv for P2P expert weight transfers
run_nixl_eplb_communicator: run the NixlEplbCommunicator backed by NIXL READ transfers with pre-registered buffers for expert weight transfers
review_pynccl_eplb_communicator: review the PyNcclEplbCommunicator that uses PyNcclCommunicator ncclSend/ncclRecv for expert weight transfers
